title: KitsPlus
description:
Kits plugin for 1.21.11 Minecraft servers.
Kits + Random kits + Custom kits!
body:
# **This is RandomKits (Custom kits) built by LevelWiz**

This kit contains loads of different fully custom kits. Kits are always random.

### **How to use**
Command: /randomkit will give you a fully random kit. Command works forever, and if you already have a kit on you it just clears your inventory. 

### **Contact**
Since this is first version of the plugin it might be buggy. Report bugs to _levelwiz_ on Discord.
